name: akoya_request-triagestatus
_comment: Isolated followup deploy (S261) for the single Workbench triage field. Lives in its own wave so `apply-dataverse-schema --wave=2-triagestatus` creates ONLY this field (string-wave loads only this dir). Re-running the full wave2 would ALSO try to create the drifted `wmkf_appreviewersuggestion_honorariumrequest` relationship (prod has the honorarium lookup under a different SchemaName) — hence isolation, same reason as wave2-fieldprimer. Picklist values mirror shared/config/triageStatus.js (the app-side source of truth); this JSON is the Dataverse source of truth and the two MUST stay in sync. schema-apply is CREATION-ONLY (schema-apply.js:264) — it will NOT reconcile a divergent pre-existing field; run scripts/preflight-triagestatus-field.mjs FIRST. MUST carry NO PowerAutomate trigger (verify post-deploy). Publisher prefix wmkf; precedent wmkf_ai_FieldPrimer self-deployed to akoya_request. Catalogued in docs/atlas/dataverse-akoya-request.md and docs/WORKBENCH_TRIAGE_FIELD_BUILD_PLAN.md.

attributes.description: Workbench triage: staff winnowing of a proposal — in-contention vs set-aside. Reversible, VISIBILITY-ONLY (drives the Workbench dashboard going-forward filter); NOT the official Phase I->II status flip, NOT the board 'Invited' signal, NOT the doc-arrival 'Phase II Pending' signal. null/unset = untriaged. Set via POST /api/workbench/triage (hard manage gate: lead PD or superuser). Additively extensible for J27. See docs/WORKBENCH_TRIAGE_FIELD_BUILD_PLAN.md.
